fusions.name: Plucked Strand
fusions.desc: Flicks a plucked strand that hits the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gossamer Thread
fusions.desc: Looses a fan of fine strands in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Plumage Screen
fusions.desc: Spreads a screen of braided plumage 6 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fluffed Up
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
